subject: Whistic steward swap + ephemeral upload window for evidence bundle
messages:
From: Ava Thomson <ava.thomson@clearwave.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Whistic owner + transient evidence upload window

Hi Rohan / Marissa,

We're reassigning the Whistic stewardship for Clearwave's security profile and need Redwood to: 1) confirm who will be the delegated steward on your side, and 2) open a short upload window so we can ingest your SOC2/SIG artifacts that require proof-of-possession.

The items we're expecting: signed SIG responses, SOC2 evidence snapshots (pdfs), and a manifest of items that need presigned S3 uploads. If possible provide a 48-hour window and an account with temporary upload permissions or a presign manifest we can use.

We also want to rotate the admin contact on the profile from ben@clearwave.com to security@clearwave.com after the upload is complete.

Thanks — happy to join a 30-min call if helpful.

Best,
Ava Thomson
Sr. Security Program Manager
Clearwave Systems

Attachment: whistic_requirements_03-04.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Ava Thomson <ava.thomson@clearwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whistic owner + transient evidence upload window

Thanks Ava — we can handle this.

Plan proposal:
- Delegated steward: Marissa Cole will be the profile owner for the Clearwave Whistic entry during the intake.
- Upload window: propose Tue 2026-03-10 08:00 PT -> Wed 2026-03-11 08:00 PT (24 hours). If you need 48h we can extend to Thu 08:00 PT but we'd prefer to keep it short to limit transient creds.
- Presign approach: Jordan will generate a presign manifest (CSV) and short-lived presigned PUT URLs for the object set. We only require an index manifest and SHA256 hashes for proof-of-possession.

Jordan — can you prepare the presign manifest and a small readme for Clearwave with upload steps + maximum file size limits? Marissa will own the final profile update and will do the admin contact swap once the bundle shows as received.

Ava — can you confirm the list of filenames or a top-level folder name you will push? If you prefer to SFTP instead of presign, say so and we'll arrange.

-Rohan
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: internal_playbook_link: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/security/whistic-upload-playbook (link)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Thomson <ava.thomson@clearwave.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whistic owner + transient evidence upload window

Confirmed — I will be stewarding the upload and profile edits.

A couple of implementation notes:
- We require each uploaded artifact to include a corresponding CAIQ/SIG mapping line in the manifest (column: control_id). That helps us wire the evidence to the questionnaire automatically.
- For SOC2 PDF snapshots, please put the year and control prefix in the filename (e.g., 2025_SOC2_CC6.pdf).
- Jordan — please cap presigned PUT URLs at 6 hours TTL and 5GB per object. We'll accept multi-part if needed.

Ava — if you can share a small sample file (1–2 MB) under the folder name "clearwave_whistic_upload_03-2026" we will do a preflight check first thing Tue morning. That preflight will verify hashes and sample CAIQ mapping.

I'll handle swapping admin contact to security@clearwave.com once the profile shows the new uploaded artifacts.

Thanks — Marissa
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): whistic_mapping_template.csv (will upload after Jordan presigns)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ava Thomson <ava.thomson@clearwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 15:40:00 -0700

> Confirmed — I will be stewarding the upload and profile edits.

Hi Ava — presign manifest attached and sample readme included.

What I generated:
- presign_manifest.csv (columns: filename, s3_key, expires_at, sha256)
- whistic_access_manifest.csv (same as above, attached to this thread)
- readme_upload.txt (upload steps, curl example using presigned PUT)

TTL: all presigned PUT URLs are set to 6 hours. Max object size: 5GB. If you need multipart we can coordinate.

I've placed two sample presigned entries for the sample file you mentioned so you can test the flow before Tue.

Attaching: presign_manifest.csv, whistic_access_manifest.csv, sig_responses_03-06.pdf (redacted sample)

If the preflight passes, Marissa will mark the profile and I'll hand off the final manifest to Clearwave.

-Jordan Blake
